احتضنتم (form VIII)
# اِحْتَضَنْتُمْ (iḥtaḍantum) /iħ.ta.dˤan.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# اُحْتُضِنْتُمْ (uḥtuḍintum) /uħ.tu.dˤin.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
